fields.label: Effective From
fields.description: The rule that applies to a return period is the newest active rule dated on or before that period's END date. Supersede a rule by adding a NEW one with a later date rather than editing this one — that is what keeps a filed quarter reproducible after the law changes.

fields.label: Target Return Box
fields.description:
ZATCA box for standard-rated sales to government entities. A field, not a constant, because ZATCA has renumbered the return before.

LEAVE BLANK to defer without splitting the box: the supplies are still held back until they are due, but when released they join ordinary standard-rated sales in box 1. Some filers disclose the split, some do not — the deferral is the tax treatment, the box is only presentation.

fields.label: Tax Due Date Basis
fields.description: When output VAT on a government supply becomes declarable. 'receipt_only' = when payment is received. 'order_only' = when the payment order is issued. 'earlier_of_receipt_or_order' = whichever comes first. 'invoice_date' disables deferral entirely, so the rule can be switched off forward-dated without deleting history.

fields.label: Payment Order Date Field
fields.description: Fieldname on Sales Invoice holding the payment-order (أمر الدفع) date, e.g. a custom field custom_payment_order_date. ERPNext has no native field for this. Leave blank and the order basis falls back to receipt.

fields.label: Credit Note Presentation
fields.description: How a credit note against a deferred government invoice is shown. 'gross_with_adjustment' puts the full invoice in Amount and the credit note in Adjustment — the ZATCA three-column layout. 'net_of_credit_notes' releases only the surviving balance into Amount. The VAT is identical either way; only the two disclosed figures differ.

fields.options: A customer is governmental if a row below names them explicitly, otherwise if their Customer Group is listed. An explicit row always wins, in both directions.

fields.label: Output VAT Account
fields.description: Optional. Blank falls back to the accounts the VAT engine already resolves from tags and heuristics.

fields.label: Deferred Output VAT Account
fields.description: Optional. Where VAT on undeclared government supplies is parked, if the company reclassifies it out of Output VAT. Reporting only — Insight never posts.
